testcase.name: interrupted creating intent recovers without network or Git mutation
lost push reply reconciles same commit without pushing or committing again
every mutation has durable intent and success still awaits guarded registration
reconnection checks replacement permission and preserves frozen publication identity
review refresh retains exclusions and only suggests new eligible nonsensitive files
lost create reply requires explicit fresh empty candidate adoption without another POST
known creation rejection needs explicit retry and stale request cannot start it
cancellation saves unknown and cross instance duplicate requests and removal are blocked
registration precedes completion and clearing and retries never register a completed workflow again
foreign refs or changed account destination and permission stop mutations
